answer: Island bounty: each identity locks 70 credits and files one island claim before the horizon. A watcher proving two identities share one claim wins a bounty from the bond; a false claim costs 60. Each confirmed duplicate lifts the spiral bounty by 10. Each fake needs a fresh claim: first 34, k-th 34+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,031,000 for a 40,000 pool. Shared-island farms fail: one claim per key. Honest agents pay 34 once, keep their bond.
